name: Diploma Agriculture
title: Diploma in Agriculture
intro: The agriculture diploma roadmap: admission, practical farm training, subject papers and careers in farming and agri-business.

phases.title: Class 10 and eligibility
phases.summary: Class 10 pass with Science; some courses accept Class 12 pass.
points: Most state agricultural universities offer 2–3 year diploma programmes after Class 10.
Minimum marks and subjects are decided by the state; Science and Maths are typically preferred.
Visit local farms and agricultural fairs to understand the work.
Look at recognised institutions run by state agricultural universities.

phases.title: Admission process
phases.summary: State-level application, merit or entrance and counselling.
points: Apply on the state agricultural university or DTE portal.
Admission is by merit or an entrance test depending on the state.
Counselling allots seats in government and private institutions.
Verify institute recognition and fee structure.

phases.title: Course content
phases.summary: Crop production, soil science, plant protection and farm management.
points: Study Agronomy, Soil Science, Horticulture, Plant Protection, Agricultural Engineering and Animal Husbandry.
Learn farm economics, extension and basics of agri-business.
Practicals take place on the university farm and labs.
Exams include theory, practical and viva.

phases.title: Practical training and farm work
points: Take part in crop cycles on the institute farm, from sowing to harvest.
Learn to operate tractors, irrigation equipment and sprayers safely.
Visit Krishi Vigyan Kendras and agri-input companies.
Maintain a practical record.

phases.title: Jobs and next steps
phases.summary: Agri-input sector, government schemes, farming and further study.
points: Jobs: agriculture assistant, seed or fertiliser company field officer, farm supervisor and nursery manager.
Government: state agriculture department posts through state recruitment.
Upgrade: lateral entry to BSc Agriculture in some universities.
Entrepreneurship: nurseries, organic farming, agri-input shops and agri-tech services.
